metadata_xml.name: Multi-state occurrence data and predictors for amphibians in Yosemite National Park (2007-2021).xml

audit_scope: metadata XML only; extract FGDC entity/attribute labels and definitions without opening any CSV
separation_requirement: proceed only if metadata supports yose_site_data.csv as a complete response-independent site registry/geometry or site-predictor table and places species occurrence/observation state in physically distinct site-year or survey tables
next_if_supported: freeze exact yose_site_data.csv identity and selectively open only that file for site-registry and structural geometry Gate 1
stop_if_unsupported: close unmerged without opening any CSV row
